text:
Maria S: Hey team — customer wants a POC that uses their HSM (BYO-KMS) + a key escrow requirement. They asked for automated rotation every 30 days, cross-region replication of wrapped keys, and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. Can we confirm feasibility and cost impact?
Alex H: Yep feasible. Two cap notes: 1) if they want our hosted plan + BYO keys we need Private/Dedicated to meet isolation + HSM connectivity, 2) HSM bring-your-own usually has a one-time onboarding ops fee. :+1:
David (SE): Technical notes — we support CloudHSM and on-prem KMIP-compatible HSMs for BYOK. For POC we can do either: a proxy that talks to customer's HSM over VPN, or temporary per-POC HSM in our VPC. Rotation every 30d is fine; we manage key wrapping/unwrapping but the customer keeps the master KEK in their HSM.
Maria S: Are there any blockers for rotation automation? customer is strict about not exposing raw keys.
David (SE): No blockers. Flow roughly: 1) import wrapped model key to our serving nodes via secure channel, 2) when rotation triggered we request unwrap from their HSM via KMIP or custom API, rewrap with new KEK, update store. We never store unencrypted master keys.
Nina (Security): Quick sec checklist: need documented key custody model in SOW, proof of meeting FIPS 140-2 (or 140-3) for their HSM, signed key ceremony log, and streaming of audit events to their SIEM. Also confirm whether they require HSM-backed attestations (e.g., PKCS#11 certs).
Maria S: They explicitly asked for key escrow — want a secondary escrow key in their legal entity and a sealed copy with their auditors. Any precedent?
Alex H: We typically offer key escrow integration as part of Private deployments — we can store an encrypted backup of wrapped keys to an S3 bucket encrypted with their escrow KEK. That adds an ops + storage line item.
Paul (Ops): Timeline estimates for a POC: VPN + network setup 3 business days, HSM handshake + test rotations 4-6 business days, SIEM integration ~2 days. Total ~2 weeks if customer is responsive. If they need hardware provisioning or on-prem handoffs expect +1–2 weeks.
Maria S: Pricing question — what should I quote for the one-time onboarding and monthly HSM connector?
Alex H: Ballpark: one-time onboarding $8k–12k (network, key ceremony, validation), monthly connector/ops $2k–4k depending on throughput and number of key rotations. Also factor in Dedicated node costs for reserved capacity. I'll follow up with exact SKU.
David (SE): For the POC scope I suggest we limit model size to 8k context and cap qps to avoid needing extra GPUs — saves cost. We can enable rotation tests with a synthetic workload.
Maria S: They also submitted a security questionnaire (attached link). Nina, can you take a first pass on answers for KMS/HSM sections?
Nina (Security): On it. I'll flag any answers that require legal signoff (e.g., escrow custody terms).
DeployBot: Incident: vpn-deploy-1876 completed successfully — env-vpn-123 ready
Paul (Ops): Next steps: 1) SE to prep HSM handshake playbook + test script, 2) Sales to send draft SOW with escrow language, 3) Security to review questionnaire answers, 4) Ops to schedule VPN window. Can we do a sync Thurs 10am PT?
Maria S: Thurs 10am PT works for customer and us. I'll send calendar invite and attach the questionnaire link + initial scope. Thanks all. :shipit:
